items.title: West Michigan officials attend closed data center seminar amid protests in Dorr Township
items.dek: More than 100 municipal leaders from Allegan, Barry and Kent counties gathered for a private educational session on data center planning while dozens of residents protested outside with 'No Data Center' signs; Microsoft has eyed land in the township, which remains under moratorium until spring 2027.
items.judge_note: Incremental follow-up on the West Michigan closed-door session already live, adding protest detail and attendance numbers but no new decision or filing.
